What I can do for you

Small, clearly scoped starts work best.

UI test automation

Tests for your key user journeys in Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, running in your CI on every change.

API testing

Status codes, response structure, login and permissions, and bad-input cases, with a written list of every defect.

Performance testing

Load and stress tests with a plain answer to how many users it can take and what breaks first.

Manual and exploratory testing

A few days of testing before a release, then a ranked report of bugs with steps and evidence.

How I work

  1. You describe the app

    What it does, how often you release, and what worries you most.

  2. I propose a clear scope

    What will be tested, what you will receive, and a delivery date.

  3. You get evidence, not opinions

    Regular updates, every defect with steps and a screenshot, and everything in a repository you own.

Send a few lines about your project: what it does, what you release, and what worries you most. I reply with a clear scope and a delivery date.
